text:
elaine: Heads up — found a regression in 1.12.3 that can cause KV-cache eviction to be overly aggressive under warm-starts. Thinking a minimal 1.12.4 patch (no API change). Can we fast-track a canary and patch bump? @sam @pranav

sam: Ack. If it's 3 lines in the cache logic that's easy. Do we need a changelog entry or infra tweaks?

elaine: It's just the threshold math in cache_manager.cc — PR #5421. No infra changes. I drafted a changelog snippet: 'Fix: reduce premature KV-cache evictions under warm-starts (regression from 1.12.3)'.

tess: +1 for canary. Recommend 10% traffic in us-west-2 for 30m, monitor latency & error spikes.

pranav: I'll own smoke tests and perf checks. Ping me when PR is merged to release/1.12.x branch. Also will run the traffic replay job.

elaine: Proposing cutoff 18:00 PT today for inclusion in 1.12.4. Need: merged PR, changelog, version bump, and smoke green. I'll prep the changelog PR.

release-bot: Scheduled action: canary deployment to us-west-2 at 15:30 PT once release/1.12.4 branch exists and CI passes.

sam: I'll do the cherry-pick and bump. Plan: create branch release/1.12.4-slim, apply #5421, open PR #5423 to bump version + quick release note. Will run `./scripts/build_release.sh --branch release/1.12.4-slim` and post CI link.

tess: Also add a rollback guard: automatic rollback if p99 latency increases > 3% or error rate > 0.5% during canary window.

sam: Cherry-pick complete, PR #5423 opened (includes version bump). CI started: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

pranav: Smoke jobs passing on canary image (unit, integ, replay). No perf regressions observed in prelim tests.

elaine: Great. Once CI finishes we'll flip canary. If anything appears, we'll revert PR #5423 and re-open investigation. Thanks all — I'm on standby for the cut. :thumbsup:
